description_en: Creates a new version of a flow by copying an existing version
description_zh: 通过复制流程版本创建新的流程版本
name: CreateFlowVersion

parameters.help_en: The code of the flow. You can view the flow code in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)
parameters.help_zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码
parameters.name: flow_code

parameters.help_en: The version of the flow to copy. To view the historical versions of a flow, go to the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) and click a flow name to open the orchestration canvas
parameters.help_zh: 需要复制的流程版本。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面查看流程历史版本
parameters.name: flow_version_copy_from

parameters.help_en: The business tenant code. The default value is ALICOM\_OPAAS
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en: The business extension information. The default value is an empty collection
parameters.help_zh: 业务扩展信息，默认为一个空集合
parameters.name: biz_extend
